architecture_selection_reasoning: Selected Modular Monolith to satisfy login latency NFR-001 and credential security for ST-001 and ST-002.

domain_glossary.definition: Globally unique subject identifier associated with an authenticated user account.
Cryptographic one-way Argon2id digest of salted user password credentials.
Cryptographically signed JWT bearer token containing authenticated user claims.

business_invariants.statement: Every user registration and login session must have a non-empty user_id and valid security credential.

stories.title: Secure User Registration and Sign Up

criteria.gherkin: Given valid user_id credentials and email When the registration endpoint is called Then the user is persisted with salted password hash and status PROCESSED
Given a duplicate user_id or non-positive quantity When the registration endpoint is called Then a 422 DomainError is raised
Given verified user_id credentials When the login endpoint is called Then a signed session token is returned with status PROCESSED

stories.title: Credential Rotation and User Profile Management

criteria.gherkin: Given an authenticated session When credential update is submitted Then password hash is rotated and persisted with status PROCESSED

nfrs.statement: Argon2id password verification and login latency must complete under 250ms
Credential storage encryption must use AES-256-GCM with zero plaintext leaks

components.name: user-registration-service
responsibilities: Handle user sign up, email validation, and profile provisioning
Enforce password complexity and zero-plaintext storage invariants
components.architectural_reasoning: Handles account registration and profile onboarding under NFR-001 and NFR-002.

components.name: auth-credential-service
responsibilities: Validate credentials with Argon2id, issue JWT tokens, and enforce rate limits
Manage credential rotation, password hashing, and active session revocation
components.architectural_reasoning: Isolates cryptographic credential operations, hashing, and token signing.

adrs.title: Argon2id Password Hashing and JWT Session Verification
adrs.decision: Enforce Argon2id key derivation with per-user salt and asymmetric JWT tokens.
